# hyperfluid_agent (Resource)

A Sapience AI agent in an environment; a capability is one with a `speciality` and a `subagent_of`. Needs the organization's `sapience_agent_enabled` feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperfluid_environment" "default" {
  name = "default"
}

data "hyperfluid_service_account" "reader" {
  name = "agent-reader"
}

# A routing agent dispatches each question to the capability that answers it.
resource "hyperfluid_agent" "support" {
  env           = data.hyperfluid_environment.default.id
  name          = "support"
  speciality    = "routing"
  system_prompt = "You help our analysts find and read their data."

  inference = {
    provider = "sapience"
    model    = "sapience:shared/qwen3-32b"
  }
}

# A capability: the platform names it and fills its system prompt and tools.
resource "hyperfluid_agent" "sql" {
  env                = data.hyperfluid_environment.default.id
  speciality         = "data-sql"
  subagent_of        = hyperfluid_agent.support.slug
  mission            = "Answer from the sales tables only."
  service_account_id = data.hyperfluid_service_account.reader.id

  inference = {
    provider = "sapience"
    model    = "sapience:shared/qwen3-32b"
  }

  data_sources = [
    {
      data_dock_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
      slug         = "sales"
      tables       = ["sales.public.orders"]
    },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `env` (String) Environment id. Changing this forces a new agent.
- `inference` (Attributes) Model the agent runs on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inference))

### Optional

- `budgets` (Attributes) Spending limits per question; omitted, the runtime derives them from the model. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--budgets))
- `context` (String) Extra context appended to the system prompt.
- `data_sources` (Attributes List) Data docks the agent may read. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_sources))
- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `desired_state` (String) `Running` (the default for a new agent) or `Stopped`.
- `interfaces` (Set of String) Where the agent is reachable: `web` (when omitted), `mail`, `slack` or `discord`.
- `mail` (Attributes) Mailbox of the `mail` interface; removing it keeps the current one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mail))
- `mission` (String) A capability's own instructions, added to its system prompt.
- `name` (String) Name, unique in the organization; a capability may omit it to be named after its agent. Changing this forces a new agent.
- `question_set` (List of String) Questions the agent asks to understand a request.
- `service_account_id` (String) Id of the service account the agent authenticates as; it must be viewer-scoped.
- `speciality` (String) What the agent is for: `routing`, `platform-ops`, `data-sql`, `documents` or your own value.
- `subagent_of` (String) Slug of the routing agent this capability answers for.
- `system_prompt` (String) System prompt; omitted, a capability the platform offers gets its own.
- `tools` (List of String) Tools: `ask_sender`, `hfctl` or `hfctl:<command>`; `[]` allows all, and omitted takes the speciality's own set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `mail_address` (String) Address the agent is reachable at by mail.
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase, e.g. `Running`, `Stopped` or `AwaitingServiceAccount`.
- `slug` (String) Derived slug; capabilities name their agent by it in `subagent_of`.
- `status_message` (String) Detail on the current phase.

<a id="nestedatt--inference"></a>
### Nested Schema for `inference`

Required:

- `provider` (String) `sapience` or `openrouter`.

Optional:

- `api_key_secret_id` (String) Id of the secret holding the OpenRouter API key.
- `endpoint_url` (String) Base URL of a `custom` provider, for tests.
- `model` (String) Model: `sapience:shared/<name>`, `sapience:org/<name>` or an OpenRouter model id.


<a id="nestedatt--budgets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `budgets`

Optional:

- `max_completion_tokens` (Number) Completion tokens per turn.
- `max_turns` (Number) Tool-call round trips per question.


<a id="nestedatt--data_sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_sources`

Required:

- `data_dock_id` (String) Data dock id.
- `slug` (String) Data dock slug.

Optional:

- `tables` (Set of String) Tables (`catalog.schema.table`) the agent may read; omitted, the whole dock.


<a id="nestedatt--mail"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mail`

Optional:

- `allowed_senders` (Set of String) Senders the agent answers, as an address or `@domain`. Omitted, everyone.
- `display_name` (String) Name recipients see.
- `from_address` (String) From address of replies. External mode only.
- `imap_host` (String) IMAP host. External mode only.
- `imap_port` (Number) IMAP port. External mode only.
- `mode` (String) `external` (your own mailbox) or `managed` (provisioned by the platform).
- `password_secret_id` (String) Id of the secret holding the mailbox password. External mode only.
- `smtp_host` (String) SMTP host. External mode only.
- `smtp_port` (Number) SMTP port. External mode only.
- `use_tls` (Boolean) TLS on the mail connections. External mode only.
- `username` (String) IMAP and SMTP login. External mode only.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Agent import id is the agent id (uuid).
terraform import hyperfluid_agent.support 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
